scripts.lint: biome check src frontend test vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts package.json biome.json tsconfig*.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.frontend.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir dist/staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist/production
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
